correctness.rationale: PASS: For z=(2c−a−b)/(b−a)>1, Legendre parity and positive-coefficient monotonicity give exact |P_n(z)/P_n(z0)| vs unity according to c relative to a+b, including every finite degree. Exterior Laplace asymptotic gives factor q^{2n+1}/(πsqrt(z²−1)) for (2n+1)P_n(z)^2. With one N(0,1) spike and d−1 midpoint uniform bulk, orthogonality gives mean denominator ≈(d−1)/(2n+1), derivative Markov bound gives O(n³/d) relative quadrature error, and Gaussian fourth moments give vanishing relative variance under d/n^4→∞. Slutsky yields (d/q^{2n})R_n⇒[q/(πsqrt(z²−1))]χ¹² and the strict mass trichotomy. Independent degree-2,5,12,25 recurrence/norm/reflection checks support, not replace, proof.
